Aug. 31 September Sep. Ist Roy John Lawry of Windsor - 4 - bright boy but sadly wanting in spinal condition. Without miracle will never be able to walk.
1944, September
Wanda Zygailo - 26 - very much like paralyzed - so weak are her knees .... asked about holy Communion - "have not been for 6 or 7 years. Promises to go to confession and Com. Enrolled - $30.
Page 166 Sep. Ist Joseph Camm - 56 0 threatened with cancer operation .... Enrolled whole family - and PP. Souls for 25 + 25 fifty times.
See James J. McLinn - 2 - conjenital cateract; Drs. hope that by operation sight may be rec'd - next
Sister of this child had astonishing recovery of "dead finger" 2'2 years ago.
Aloysius and Barbara Gabrysh - married over a year and k no indi- cation of family .... Enrolls Family doubly and offers $100.00 be- sides for missions.
